description: This source file defines the 'AlwaysUserMuteStrategy' class, which implements a user mute strategy that always mutes the user during the bot's speaking turns. It extends from a base strategy class, handles frame processing to determine whether the user should be muted based on bot speaking frames, and includes methods for initialization and state resetting.

classes.name: AlwaysUserMuteStrategy
classes.description: Implements a user mute strategy that always mutes during the bot's speaking periods. It maintains an internal state to track whether the bot is speaking and provides methods to reset this state or process incoming frames to update the mute status.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the strategy, setting the internal speaking flag to False.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state, setting the bot speaking flag to False.

methods.name: bool process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame to update the mute state based on whether the frame indicates the bot has started or stopped speaking.
